gpt-4o-mini.title: Existentialism Is a Humanism
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A foundational text where Sartre outlines the principles of existentialism in an accessible manner.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Existentialism and human emotions
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: In this philosophical exploration, Jean-Paul Sartre delves into the complexities of existentialism and its impact on human emotions, challenging readers to confront the essence of freedom, choice, and the nature of existence. gpt-4o-mini.title: The Transcendence of the Ego
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A key text that discusses the nature of consciousness and the self from an existentialist perspective.

gemma2:9b.explanation: A foundational work in existentialist philosophy, exploring concepts like consciousness and freedom.

gemma2:9b.title: Existentialism Is a Humanism
